zones.rationale: Within the single MCP cluster, these views summarize columns, lounge seating, reception counters, elevators/piano landmarks, and blue patterned carpet rather than round banquet tables.
These views summarize round white banquet tables, covered chairs, beige panel walls, and doorway/exit landmarks around the far banquet end of the same merged cluster.
Both views summarize corridor or lobby-transition passages with window walls, floral artwork, or blurry columned circulation rather than seated lounge or banquet table clusters.
Entrance-side positions summarize an information counter, green digital screens, glass doors, stairs, and lobby furnishings distinct from deeper gallery panels.
These contiguous gallery positions summarize red panels, stone ruins, metal mesh partitions, illustrated panels, and corridor-style exhibition walls along the primary museum walkthrough.
These views repeatedly reference Reichenstein title/information panels, artifact shelves, display tables, tall windows, and a small media seating corner.
The single view at (36.25, 0.30, 1.93) summarizes a reconstructed workshop with stove, tools, work table, and red walls, semantically separate from surrounding panel galleries.
These views summarize narrow backstage passages, schedule boards, white doors/cabinets, and emergency signage rather than audience-facing lounge or foyer space.
The stage-side position summarizes a black curtain backdrop with podium and lectern, clearly distinct from corridor and lounge summaries.
Both views describe red seating or notice walls with digital schedule screens and timetable boards near the mid-level lobby positions.
These lounge positions summarize sofas, chandeliers, photo walls, a wall-mounted TV, and a keyboard corner in the theater green-room cluster around z≈-17.
Views farther along negative z summarize grand staircases, glass entrance doors, balcony railings, and public foyer corridors rather than backstage service passages.
Within MCP cluster 0, these nearer positions summarize outdoor stairs, cobblestone walkways, glass-block entrances, turquoise supports, and beige courtyard facades.
Also from MCP cluster 0, these farther positions summarize narrow alleys, underpass columns, red facades, utility containers, and service corners along the peripheral building edge.
MCP cluster 1 is the isolated position at z=66.2 whose summary describes a tree-lined street with parked cars and open roadway, not the courtyard/alley facades.
MCP cluster 0 centers on positions whose summaries repeatedly describe the fortress island, marina, waterfront buildings, and nearby open water.
MCP cluster 1 groups blurred east-side aerial positions summarizing distant coastline, bay water expanse, and bridge or roadway lines away from the fortress core.
MCP cluster 2 preserves the west-side aerial pair summarizing coastal city mass, bright overexposed sky/glare, and a linear bridge or road across the bay horizon.
